job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed mtp-mtp_seq-c-c67a71fe5-tc (dsfd_mtp_seq, RTL c67a71fe5, snapshot of 7 drifted files): same RTL, outline 151.2x151.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:mtp-rom

benches.name: pass_s0_tr_forced
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/dsrom_mtp_rom_bench.py one s0_tr_forced --out {RUN}/bench
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the c67a71fe5 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src]
